notice: P11-r4 — Opus + charging lights + reconnect fix. Application-only sample-test prerelease for 603V1.23.2, independently based on released P10 revision 2. BLE/TCP speed tests, motion sampling/tasks, swipe output and firmware duration-based deletion are disabled. Bluetooth reconnect no longer interrupts an active local PTT recording or memo. Hold/release, deliberate stops, transfer and receipt-controlled cleanup remain. Requires the updated P11-capable iPhone app and its revision-aware catalog. A Ring already reporting P11 can install Opus revisions r2/r4; ADPCM-only revisions remain blocked because Opus recordings may exist. Software and signed-package checks passed; physical boot, timing, power, custody and recovery remain unproven. Locally signed with the supplier DFU key, without supplier acceptance. No Ring was flashed by this task.
